changes.reason: Add a focused JS job for registered backend-independent fixed compute/join test-only changes, including new tests. Run every changed file and its stable owning family with package compilation and nonzero execution guards. Preserve mandatory full-history preflight, artifact contracts, lint and spec; omit unrelated runtime and proof families only after exact raw inventory, fixture and target-boundary admission.
